attacks.definition: (Dumpster Diving) Searching trash for sensitive information.
(Domain Name System Cache Poisoning) Corrupts DNS cache.
(Address Resolution Protocol Poisoning) Spoofs MAC addresses on a network.
(Cross-Site Request Forgery) Forces users to execute unwanted actions.
(Quid Pro Quo) Offering help in exchange for information.
(Business Email Compromise) Impersonating executives for fraud.
(Remote Access Trojan) Malware disguised as legitimate software.
Network of infected devices used for attacks.
(Internet of Things Distributed Denial of Service) Compromised IoT.
(Trojan Horse) Malware disguised as legitimate software.
Deceptive emails tricking users into revealing information.
Leaving infected media to lure victims.
(Typosquatting) Using similar domain names to deceive users.
